title: Girard marketplace CLI plugin
description: One agent CLI plugin in the Girard marketplace: plugins/<id>/plugin.json. The folder name is the plugin's id. Girard installs it with each CLI's own plugin manager.

description.description: One sentence on what it does for the agents.

source.description: The plugin marketplace to add: a GitHub owner/repo or an https Git URL. Each CLI's `plugin marketplace add` is given it as-is.

marketplace.description: The marketplace's name in the source's marketplace.json. Defaults to the id.

plugin.description: The plugin's name in that marketplace. Defaults to the id.

requires.description: Commands that must be on PATH for the plugin to work, such as python3.

notes.description: Per CLI, one or two sentences shown after installing: setup steps the user has to do.
